name: Huge Whistle Collection (Full Audio Fun Set)

captions.detailed: This 3D model features a set of four stepped whistles arranged vertically in a single stacked piece. Each whistle consists of a cylindrical main body and an integrated rectangular mouthpiece extending from one side, creating a staircase-like appearance. Rectangular air slots are cut into the flat top surfaces of the mouthpieces, while the main bodies are hollowed out to act as resonant sound chambers.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric multi-tone whistle set in OpenSCAD. The script should define a module for a single whistle with customizable radius, height, length, and wall thickness, and stack multiple whistles on top of each other with varying dimensions to create a stepped, multi-pitch whistle block.
captions.factory: The design uses a custom 'pfeife' module instantiated four times with different translations, radii, heights, and lengths. Inside the module, the main body is formed by unioning a cylinder, a rectangular cube for the mouthpiece, and a smaller connecting cube, which are then hollowed out using difference() with scaled concentric cylinders and cubes. Sound-producing features are created by subtracting angled and straight rectangular slots from the mouthpiece, and an optional small internal resonant sphere is supported on a tiny cylindrical stand.
